verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents Incident Workflows with configurable triggers and actions using 'if-this-then-that' logic, for example a workflow that fires automatically for all P1/P2 incidents. Event Orchestration adds rules that automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts, and AI Orchestrations can recommend or create those rules from historical events. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow and orchestration rule behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Through highly-configurable triggers and actions, you can apply "if-this-then-that" logic to orchestrate the right response for your teams
For example, you can configure one workflow that automatically triggers for all P1 and P2 incidents
Event Orchestration: Automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts.
automatically analyze historical events and incidents and surface recommended rules that reduce noise, improve MTTR, and accelerate automation setup
